reason: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb (the patch's website_name, the elsif branch around patch lines 74-76), the only check is that both hosts have the same number of labels (more than 2) and that everything after the first label matches. There is no public-suffix check, so evil.co.uk against forum.co.uk (or a.github.io against forum.github.io) returns website_host + path, which shows the full path for an unrelated site.
